title: (ninth RacketCon): Andrew Blinn – Fructure: A Structured Editing Engine in Racket
summary: A RacketCon talk presenting Fructure, a prototype extensible structured editing engine in Racket. Language providers define syntactic forms and refactorings as rewrite rules, and editing operates on program structure rather than on text.
why: Cited as a leading example of structural editing whenever threads discuss alternatives to text-based code editors.

quote.text: Andrew Blinn gave a neat talk[1] pertaining to structured editing at Racketcon
